mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM agent_proposals p JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.id=p.source_message_id AND m.user_id=p.user_id JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = (SELECT m.conversation_id FROM conversation_messages m JOIN agent_proposals p ON p.source_message_id=m.id AND p.user_id=m.user_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1) AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.* FROM agent_proposals p JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.id=p.source_message_id AND m.user_id=p.user_id JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.status='pending' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM agent_proposals WHERE source_message_id=#{sourceMessageId} AND user_id=#{userId}

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_proposals p JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.id=p.source_message_id AND m.user_id=p.user_id JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND c.id=#{conversationId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.kind='followup' AND p.status='rejected' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.payload_json, '$.reason'))=#{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_proposals p JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.id=p.source_message_id AND m.user_id=p.user_id JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL SET p.status='rejected', p.confirmed_at=#{at} WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND c.id=#{conversationId} AND p.kind=#{kind} AND p.status='pending'

UPDATE agent_proposals SET status=#{status}, confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.id=agent_proposals.source_message_id AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL)

UPDATE agent_proposals SET payload_json=#{payloadJson} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND kind='checkin' AND status='pending' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.id=agent_proposals.source_message_id AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL)
